description:
About the role

At NetBox Labs, we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises.

We're hiring a Regional Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives in the US. Reporting to the Head of Sales, Americas, you'll own the team quota and forecast and be the person AEs lean on to run a sharper sales process and execute deals—from intro meetings, demos, and technical alignment through negotiation and close. This is a leadership role. You'll coach and develop the team, raise the bar on qualification and deal execution, and build the operating rhythm that makes the team predictable.

What you'll do

Coach the team to win

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of Account Executives; set goals, coach weekly, and manage performance

  • Be the supporting leader in the room in early-stage deals: join intro meetings, demos, and technical alignment calls and raise the bar for discovery and qualification

  • Run MEDDPICC deal reviews and BANT-based stage gating so opportunities entering pipeline are qualified, and coach AEs on the gaps

  • Use call recordings to give specific, regular feedback on discovery, demos, objection handling, and next steps

Drive deal execution

  • Support AEs through every stage of the sales process: join key calls, shape deal strategy, and help them build champions, reach exec sponsors, and run mutual close plans

  • Step in on negotiation, pricing, and commercial terms on the team’s largest deals, and coach AEs to run these conversations themselves

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on technical wins, POCs, and the hand-off from technical validation to commercial close

Own the team number

  • Own the team quota and forecast accuracy: weekly forecast calls, commit and upside calls, and inspection of close dates, next steps, and risk

  • Own and monitor pipeline generation and coverage for your AEs. Work closely with SDRs, Field/Partner Marketing, and Channel to work on strategies & process to drive more qualified pipeline

  • Hold the standard for HubSpot hygiene: stages, BANT, MEDDPICC, forecast categories, qualification fields, and next steps that tell the true story of every deal

Build the team

  • Drive the partner motion in your team: build rep-to-rep relationships with resellers and SIs and turn them into sourced and influenced pipeline

  • Partner with Field and Partner Marketing on territory plans, events, and campaigns that create pipeline in your accounts

  • Make AI and automation the default way the team works, scaling output without scaling headcount linearly

  • Partner with Customer Success on handoffs, renewals, and expansion so new customers grow after the first deal

  • Partner with the Head of Sales, RevOps, and Global VP of Sales on territory design, capacity planning, hiring, and comp plan feedback

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in B2B enterprise software sales, including 5+ years as a quota-carrying AE closing six-figure deals in infrastructure, networking, DevOps, or security software

  • 3+ years as a front-line sales manager carrying a team quota, with a track record of leading a team to its number

  • You've hired, developed, and managed sellers, and built a repeatable process for discovery, deal review, and forecasting, not just inherited one

  • Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar) and in long-cycle deals with technical buyers and multiple stakeholders

  • Technical credibility: network engineers and infrastructure leaders take you seriously in a demo or technical alignment call

  • Forecast discipline: you call your number accurately, know how to inspect a deal, and can distinguish a real commit deal from upside

  • CRM power user (HubSpot preferred): you build your own reports and dashboards and use data to coach

  • Strong problem-solving in ambiguity: you thrive in a high-growth startup where the playbook is still being written, and you balance process with speed

  • Hands-on with AI and automation in your own workflow and in how you coach the team

  • Nice to have: open-source, developer/infrastructure software, network automation or NetBox familiarity; channel or partner sales motion experience

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed

  • Located in Central/West/Mountain Time Zone Preferred

Our stack

  • AI: Claude

  • CRM: HubSpot

  • Prospecting & data: Apollo, ZoomInfo, Nooks

  • Call recording & coaching: Fathom

  • Collaboration: Slack, Google Workspace

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
